notes: Bankers is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints all 1,000,000,000 BANKERS once to msg.sender, the factory at launch. It has no administrative powers, transfer fees, or post-construction minting. No application contracts are deployed. The pool pairs with IMD. initialPrice records provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from initialMarketCapWei and totalSupply.
